newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Shell Rotterdam import pipe to reopen Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Shell Rotterdam import pipe to reopen Thursday.

text.p: A pipeline used to import gas oil and naphtha into Shell's Pernis refinery is to reopen on Thursday after about 10 days of repairs, a source at the company said on Wednesday.
The pipeline which brings the products into the 370,000 barrel per day refinery from the Europoort terminal was closed after a crack was discovered on a weld, traders said.

A Shell spokesman said the pipeline was due to be shut for a week anyway, but the closure led Shell to buy an initial 30,000 tonnes of heating oil on the spot market at the start of last week. Traders estimated the company would have to buy a further 15,000 tonnes per day while the pipeline remained closed.
